headline: Depth と Mesh で raw camera 前の環境理解を絞る
headlineEn: Narrowing environment understanding with Depth and Mesh before raw camera access
summary: WebXR Depth Sensing Module、Mesh Detection Module、Raw Camera Access、Immersive Web proposal samples を確認し、raw camera pixels を読む前に Depth Sensing の点距離と Mesh Detection の粗い面情報で足りるかを比較する自作 HTML サンプルを追加しました。
summaryEn: After reviewing the WebXR Depth Sensing Module, Mesh Detection Module, Raw Camera Access, and Immersive Web proposal samples, today's original HTML sample compares whether point depth and coarse mesh surfaces are sufficient before reading raw camera pixels.
keyTopics: WebXR Depth Sensing Module は `depth-sensing` feature descriptor と CPU / GPU access を定義し、CPU 側では `getDepthInMeters(x, y)` により normalized view coordinates の距離を読む。
Depth Sensing は物理接触、occlusion、非視覚的な環境把握に使えるが、inline XR device は depth-sensing を support 可能な device として扱ってはいけない。
WebXR Mesh Detection Module は 2026-02-02 の Draft Community Group Report で、`mesh-detection`、`XRFrame.detectedMeshes`、`XRMesh.vertices` / `indices` / `semanticLabel` / `lastChangedTime` を定義している。
Mesh Detection は環境の 3D surface を露出するため、仕様上も polygon の vertex 数削減、座標 quantization、小さすぎる mesh の非公開化などの privacy mitigation が重要になる。
Raw Camera Access は最も露出度が高い経路として扱い、今日の公開カードでは raw pixels そのものではなく、Depth / Mesh で代替できるかを判断する自作 sampler を中心にした。
keyTopicsEn: The WebXR Depth Sensing Module defines the `depth-sensing` feature descriptor and CPU/GPU access; CPU access reads distance in normalized view coordinates through `getDepthInMeters(x, y)`.
Depth Sensing can support physical interaction, occlusion, and non-visual environment awareness, but the inline XR device must not be treated as capable of supporting the feature.

The WebXR Mesh Detection Module Draft Community Group Report dated 2026-02-02 defines `mesh-detection`, `XRFrame.detectedMeshes`, and `XRMesh.vertices`, `indices`, `semanticLabel`, and `lastChangedTime`.
Mesh Detection exposes 3D surfaces from the user's environment, so privacy mitigations such as reducing polygon vertex count, quantizing coordinates, and hiding too-small meshes are important.
Raw Camera Access remains the highest-exposure route; today's public card focuses on an original sampler that decides whether Depth or Mesh can replace raw pixels.

sections.title: 注目事例と何が面白いか
sections.titleEn: Notable example and why it matters
sections.body: 今日の注目は、Raw Camera Access の前段に Depth Sensing と Mesh Detection を置くと、AR アプリが必要とする環境理解をかなり限定できる点です。Depth Sensing は view 上の点に対する距離、Mesh Detection は tracked surface の polygon と semanticLabel を返すため、背景画像そのものを読まずに、物体配置、occlusion、近接警告、床や壁への吸着を作れます。一方で mesh も部屋の構造を露出するため、Raw Camera より軽いとはいえ、頂点数、座標精度、label の粒度を調整する gate が必要です。
sections.bodyEn: Today's notable point is that placing Depth Sensing and Mesh Detection before Raw Camera Access can sharply narrow the environmental data an AR app needs. Depth Sensing provides distance at points in the view, while Mesh Detection provides tracked-surface polygons and semantic labels, enabling placement, occlusion, proximity warnings, and wall/floor snapping without reading background images. Meshes still expose room structure, so even though they are lighter than raw camera pixels, they need gates for vertex count, coordinate precision, and label granularity.

sections.title: 表現・インタラクションのアイデア
sections.body: 今日のサンプルでは、未来的な AR scan view の中に depth sample grid、mesh polygon、raw camera crop pressure、移動可能な point probe を重ねました。Depth / Mesh / Hybrid を切り替え、sample density、mesh quantization、raw camera pressure、scene motion、surface complexity を動かすと、privacy risk、utility、route、decision が変化します。canvas をクリックまたはドラッグすると probe が移動し、近い depth 値を読みながら、raw pixels を読むべきか、depth + mesh で十分かを観察できます。
sections.bodyEn: The sample layers a depth-sample grid, mesh polygons, raw-camera crop pressure, and a movable point probe inside a futuristic AR scan view. Switching Depth, Mesh, or Hybrid and adjusting sample density, mesh quantization, raw camera pressure, scene motion, and surface complexity changes privacy risk, utility, route, and decision readouts. Clicking or dragging the canvas moves the probe, letting you observe the nearest depth value while deciding whether raw pixels are necessary or depth plus mesh is enough.

sections.title: 制作に使えそうな技術メモ
sections.body: 実装方針としては、まず `requestSession("immersive-ar", { optionalFeatures: ["depth-sensing", "mesh-detection"] })` のように環境理解を optional に寄せ、必要な体験だけ required に上げる設計が扱いやすそうです。Depth は normalized view coordinate の sampler として UI の照準や object placement に使い、Mesh は `detectedMeshes` の `lastChangedTime` を見て変化した面だけ再評価します。privacy policy では mesh vertices の quantization、semanticLabel の whitelist、細かすぎる mesh の削除、depth sampling density の制限を raw camera request より前の gate にします。
sections.bodyEn: A practical implementation could start with `requestSession("immersive-ar", { optionalFeatures: ["depth-sensing", "mesh-detection"] })`, keeping environment understanding optional unless a specific experience needs it as required. Use Depth as a normalized-view-coordinate sampler for reticles and object placement, and use Mesh Detection by checking `detectedMeshes` and reevaluating only surfaces whose `lastChangedTime` changed. A privacy policy can gate raw camera requests behind mesh-vertex quantization, semantic-label whitelists, removal of overly detailed meshes, and depth-sampling-density limits.

sections.title: サンプルデータの可能性と組み合わせ
sections.body: このサンプルからは、probe 座標、nearest depth、depth sample count、mesh count、quantization level、raw camera pressure、privacy risk、utility、route decision、event log が取れます。家具配置、展示会場ガイド、倉庫ピッキング、店舗棚前の AR 説明、AI 物体検出、WebGPU compute mask、Body Tracking の redaction policy と組み合わせると、画像を読まずに成立する体験と、画像が本当に必要な体験を分けて評価できます。特に depth / mesh / label だけで UI の吸着と occlusion が成立するなら、raw camera は診断や明示操作時だけに絞れます。
sections.bodyEn: The sample produces probe coordinates, nearest depth, depth sample count, mesh count, quantization level, raw camera pressure, privacy risk, utility, route decision, and an event log. Combining this with furniture placement, exhibition guides, warehouse picking, retail shelf overlays, AI object detection, WebGPU compute masks, or body-tracking redaction policies would separate experiences that work without image access from those that truly need images. If depth, mesh, and labels are enough for snapping and occlusion, raw camera access can be limited to diagnostics or explicit user actions.

sections.title: 明日以降ウォッチする対象
sections.body: Depth Sensing と Mesh Detection の issue、proposal samples の mesh / plane / depth 実装、mesh の semanticLabel 粒度、anchors と native mesh entity の関係、Depth の CPU access と GPU access の性能差、Raw Camera Access との同時要求時の permission UX を見ます。次は Plane Detection も含めて、mesh / plane / depth のどれを使うと anchor placement が最小露出で安定するかを比較したいです。
sections.bodyEn: Watch Depth Sensing and Mesh Detection issues, mesh/plane/depth implementations in proposal samples, semantic-label granularity, the relationship between anchors and native mesh entities, CPU versus GPU depth-access performance, and permission UX when Raw Camera Access is requested alongside these features. Next, include Plane Detection and compare whether mesh, plane, or depth gives the most stable anchor placement with the least exposure.

sections.title: 試すならこれ
sections.body: サンプルを開き、Hybrid のまま Mesh quantization を上げてください。mesh が粗くなり privacy risk が下がる一方、utility も少し落ちます。次に Raw camera pressure を上げると赤い crop 領域が強くなり、route が `Ask camera only after consent` や `Quantize or fallback` へ寄ります。最後に Private preset を押すと、depth の点サンプルだけで判断する低露出モードになります。
sections.bodyEn: Open the sample and raise Mesh quantization while staying in Hybrid mode. The mesh becomes coarser and privacy risk drops, while utility also falls slightly. Then increase Raw camera pressure to strengthen the red crop region and push the route toward `Ask camera only after consent` or `Quantize or fallback`. Finally, press the Private preset to switch to a low-exposure mode based only on point depth samples.

sections.title: 進行マップ
sections.body: 調査: Depth Sensing、Mesh Detection、Raw Camera Access、Proposal Samples、MDN getDepthInMeters を確認。設計: 2026-08-04 の raw camera crop gate から、raw pixels を要求する前に derived environment data で足りるかを判定する方向へ進める。実装: depth grid、mesh polygon、quantization、raw pressure、probe drag、risk / utility / route readout、scenario preset、rescan log を canvas + controls で作成。検証: JSON parse、HTML script 構文、全 outputs script compile、gallery 再生成、Pages 公開 URL を確認する。
sections.bodyEn: Research: reviewed Depth Sensing, Mesh Detection, Raw Camera Access, Proposal Samples, and MDN getDepthInMeters. Design: move from the 2026-08-04 raw-camera crop gate toward deciding whether derived environment data is sufficient before requesting raw pixels. Implementation: built a canvas and controls with a depth grid, mesh polygons, quantization, raw pressure, probe dragging, risk/utility/route readouts, scenario presets, and a rescan log. Validation: parse JSON, check HTML script syntax, compile all output scripts, regenerate the gallery, and verify published Pages URLs.

sections.title: 俯瞰メモ
sections.body: ここ数日の流れは、permission、body tracking、raw camera、depth / mesh と、現実空間から得られるデータをどこまで抽象化して使うかに集約されています。Raw Camera は表現力が高い一方で露出が大きく、Depth と Mesh は表現の自由度を少し落としながら、AR の実用タスクには十分なことが多いです。公開サイトのサンプルとしては、派手な映像処理の前に、どのデータで十分かを見極める小さな UI を蓄積する方が、後から実機や AI に接続しやすくなります。
sections.bodyEn: The recent sequence around permissions, body tracking, raw camera, and depth/mesh is converging on how far real-world data can be abstracted before use. Raw Camera is expressive but highly exposing, while Depth and Mesh reduce creative freedom slightly and still cover many practical AR tasks. For this public sample archive, accumulating small UIs that decide which data is sufficient before building flashy image processing makes it easier to later connect real devices or AI.

sections.title: 今日のミニ試作候補
sections.body: 採用した候補は `Depth Mesh Privacy Sampler` です。実 XR session は開始せず、Depth Sensing の `getDepthInMeters()` 風の点距離、Mesh Detection の `detectedMeshes` 風 polygon、Raw Camera Access の crop pressure を canvas 上で比較します。次に足すなら、Plane Detection との比較、mesh polygon への anchor 作成、depth GPU texture 風 shader preview、semanticLabel whitelist、AI label redaction queue を追加します。
sections.bodyEn: The selected prototype is `Depth Mesh Privacy Sampler`. It does not start a real XR session; it compares Depth Sensing-style point distances, Mesh Detection-style `detectedMeshes` polygons, and Raw Camera Access crop pressure on a canvas. Useful next additions are Plane Detection comparison, anchor creation on mesh polygons, a depth-GPU-texture-style shader preview, semantic-label whitelists, and an AI label redaction queue.
